title: The Infinite Carousel of Sideways Turning

features.name: carousel-horse
features.desc-on-touch: You watch it turn and turn, but never the way you expect. Each rotation carries it sideways through space.

features.name: spiral-tower
features.desc-on-touch: It spirals upward but also inward; you cannot track which direction it turns. At its crown, something else spirals back down.

features.name: sidewise-arch
features.desc-on-touch: The arch leans at an angle that shouldn't support anything. Riders pass through it sideways, their motion perpendicular to your eye.

features.name: echo-pool
features.desc-on-touch: The surface reflects not the carousel but itself at different times, each reflection turning in its own direction.

features.name: tangent-glyph
features.desc-on-touch: A symbol for motion that never aligns with itself. The more you look at it, the more it seems to drift sideways off the surface.

features.name: circuit-knot
features.desc-on-touch: Electrical traces form a knot that cannot be untangled because it was never tied—it spawned this way, twisted through dimensions the carousel alone understands.

inscription: the carousel turns where the horses run, and the riders slip sideways through the turning, and there is always another horse ahead spiraling away

file.name: Carousel_Recordings_Layered_1987_to_Now.mp3
file.note: Field recordings of carnival music playing at different speeds, each bleeding into the next—no beginning, no end, just an endless harmonic drift through itself

exits.label: back up through the spiraling carnival where each turn is the same turn
toward the platform where watchers still and all else circles
the exit where riders finally learn to step sideways off
